Name: Diotrephes
Role: Lover of preeminence who refused John
Summary: Diotrephes loved to have the preeminence among the church, refused to receive John and his messengers, forbade others to do so, and cast objectors out of the church.
KeyStory: Diotrephes loved to have the preeminence among the church, refused to receive John and his messengers, forbade others to do so, and cast objectors out of the church.
LifeLesson: Loving preeminence corrupts a church faster than any outside attack.
